client: I got my psychology paper back yesterday and barely passed. Now I'm spiraling about my finals next month - I keep imagining failing everything and having to drop out of school. Everyone says I'm overreacting, but I can't shake this dread that I'm not smart enough to be here.
therapist: It sounds like this grade has really shaken your confidence, and those anxious thoughts about the future are feeling overwhelming right now. I notice you're speaking very quickly—your body seems to be matching the urgency of these worries. Would it help to slow down and unpack what this grade actually means about your abilities?
vocal_descriptors: very high pitch, soft-spoken, very rapid speech

client:
